Question B-006-002-007.

Why the correct answer is right: A balun is the device used when a balanced antenna is fed by an unbalanced line such as coax. It provides the balanced-to-unbalanced transition and may also help control common-mode current.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "A triaxial transformer": Triaxial cable has an extra conductor layer, but this is not the standard amateur device for feeding a balanced antenna from coax.
- sourceIndex 2: "A wave trap": A trap is a tuned circuit used to isolate or include parts of an antenna on different bands, not to change balance at the feed point.
- sourceIndex 3: "A loading coil": A loading coil adds inductance to make a short antenna electrically longer; it does not convert unbalanced feed to balanced feed.
